(Japanese: '''グルー''' ''Gurū'') is a minor character who appeared in ''[[M07|Destiny Deoxys]]''. He is the [[Battle judge|referee]] and announcer of [[Pokémon battle]]s that are held in the [[Battle Tower]] in [[LaRousse City]].

Gurū judged the match of {{Ash}} and [[Tory]] against [[Rafe]] and [[Sid]]. He also explained the rules of a [[Multi Battle|Tag Battle]] to the audience.
